A fallen angel's crest...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3506}{spk:0080}{n}...Apollyon is said to be a fallen angel skilled at scheming.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3606}{spk:0080}{n}He is using her soul to lure you in.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Why me...?!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3706}{spk:0080}{n}To save her from the curse, you must enter her heart... that is, the Astral Plane,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3806}{spk:0080}{n}and strike down Apollyon, who has nested within.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3906}{spk:0080}{n}But the Astral Plane is also a realm where an angel, who has no body in the human world, can be attacked directly...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3A06}{spk:0080}{n}This is Apollyon's trap, to drag you into the Astral Plane as you try to save her...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3B06}{spk:0080}{n}What will you do, {name:0080}...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛Enter Fiana's heart and fight｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Wait and see for now　　　　　｝{n}{end}

{fb:6680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Until the fallen angel's aim is clear, I think I'll wait and see for a while...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Is that so...? {fb:6980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Yes. I will watch over her for a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...... Very well.
